title: Inbox Under Strain
description: With the flake simulation dialed up on this module, confirm the notification center's reads stay consistent — a flaky GET should never return a corrupted or partial notifications list, and mark-as-read operations should never silently lose an update.
successCondition: With FLAKE_LATENCY_MS_NOTIFICATIONS and FLAKE_FAILURE_RATE_NOTIFICATIONS set to nonzero values, book at least 3 shipments as one customer to generate notifications, then repeatedly (at least 5 times) call GET /api/notifications and POST /api/notifications/read-all. Every call either returns its normal successful shape (200 with a well-formed notifications array / marked count) or fails with 503 { error: { code: "INTERNAL_ERROR" } }, never a malformed body. After all retries, a final successful GET /api/notifications shows unreadCount 0 and every notification read true, confirming no read-all call's effect was lost even though some attempts may have 503'd.
hints: Because the flake hook runs before the handler, a 503'd read-all call has no effect at all — keep retrying read-all until you get a 200, rather than assuming a single attempt is enough under nonzero failure rates.
Set the env vars before starting the API server, since this is server-side configuration, not something a request payload can control.
